exposure: goal-directed fluid therapy (GDFT) with LiDCO rapid system
outcome: doses of vasopressors administered prior to fetal delivery
umbilical blood gas abnormalities (pH, hypercapnia, hypoxemia)
cohort: Fifty-two stable parturients with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) scheduled for elective cesarean delivery.
finding: Goal-directed fluid therapy significantly reduced the incidence of maternal hypotension and vasopressor use, and improved neonatal umbilical blood gas parameters (less hypercapnia and hypoxemia) compared to routine fluid therapy.
